description: Find where to get mentioned: the pages AI answers cite for a buyer question that name your competitors but not you. Measures citations and rankings, reads up to 8 cited third-party pages and returns gaps.pages, each with the names it contains, an excerpt and an action. With requestId or trackerRunId instead of query, it measures nothing and is free. Charged only for the steps that succeed, at per-surface rates. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance, and failed calls are free; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

brand.description: Your brand or domain: the name to look for on the cited pages. A domain also marks your own pages.

competitors.description: Competitor brands/domains to look for on the cited pages.

fullSweep.description: Query all five AI surfaces (adds claude and google_ai_overview) for full cross-surface coverage, at a higher cost. Ignored when models is given.

models.description: AI surfaces to query, each billed separately; pass a subset when the user names surfaces or wants a lower cost. Omit for the defaults (chatgpt = the OpenAI API, perplexity, gemini); fullSweep queries all five. google_ai_overview accepts queries up to 700 characters, the others 2000.

query.description: Buyer question to measure. With requestId or trackerRunId, optionally one of the saved prompts to focus on.

requestId.description: A requestId from your own successful citations, rankings or workflow call within 30 days. Free.

trackerRunId.description: A finished run of one of your trackers within 30 days. Free.

url.description: Optional URL of your page: checked for citations, and its site counts as yours.

name: cite42_find_ai_citation_gaps
